mentions.name: Ꭰ-Library (perma-lib)
mentions.description: A 'perma-lib' library project named Ꭰ-Library (pronounced A-Library, after the Cherokee letter Ꭰ, U+13A0) centered on ethics and sustainable practices, intended to support education and a better world for future generations; a Kickstarter crowdfunding campaign is planned for the coming weeks.
mentions.audience: Future generations, with an emphasis on education and building a better world
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am building the perma-lib on the topic of ethics and sustainable practices: Ꭰ-Library

Pronounce A-Library "The Unicode character for the Cherokee letter 'A' (Ꭰ) is U+13A0"

Launching a kick-starter for it in the coming weeks. Hoping to make a difference for the next few generations for a better world and education.
